heavy_benchmark_decision.justification: F6 is a controlled regression audit. No numerical source changed during F3-F6; the active 5M two-replay record, 1M/3M replays, representative AIJ preallocation evidence and C3 record remain traceable and applicable. A new heavy run would be a qualification rerun rather than a regression check.

verdict.answer_to_release_question: The current commit preserves the active qualified results and shows no significant numerical or performance regression on the officially supported bounded scope. The full suite retains the three visible F4 failures in experimental or stale nonlinear paths, and optional environments remain separately bounded.
verdict.performance_claim_boundary: Only the recorded workload, hardware, PETSc/MPI environment, backend, preconditioner and configuration may be claimed; no universal speedup, hardware-independent scaling or route transfer is implied.
limitations: Three pre-existing full-suite failures remain outside the supported release matrix.
No new heavy 5M/10M replay was required or run.
Optional PETSc/MPI and external environments are covered by existing pinned evidence, not a fresh F6 host run.
C3 10M remains a bounded zero-weight capacity record and does not qualify a universal 10M claim.
